Strike hard and true!
That's the way!
Umbra hungers for you.
Harder, faster!
Gah!
I'll blast you back to Oblivion!
I'll turn your bones to ash!
Dodge this!
I've got a hex with your name on it!
You're no match for my powers!
I'll melt your flesh!
I've got all sorts of tricks up my sleeve!
Burn, you fetcher!
*Deranged Cackling*
You can't evade my spells!
What is it, Fresh Blood?
What is it, you runt?
Yes little monster - what do you want?
Your kind is not welcome here, vampire - I have nothing I wish to say to you. Speak with Sirilonwe - she seems to have an affinity for your kind.
As a child, I was taught by the Temple to despise your kind. But the Temple are a bunch of old fools - so say your piece, vampire.
Greetings, my bloodless friend. What can I do for you?
A vampire? How quaint. There are certain experiments I've had in mind for one of your kind.
Hmm. A vampire. How intriguing - what is it you want?
Say your piece and leave, vampire. We will not have you killed, but your presence here is... a nuisance.
Your kind is not welcome here, vampire. Ask me what you will and be on your way.
Yes, bloodless one? I will hear your words.
I am not your friend, bloodless one. But you have my curiosity.
I prefer my friends to be among the living, but you may speak.
I won't call for help, dark one, but you should leave.
Yes, dark one? I will tolerate your presence, but be quick about it.
A vampire? Most unusual. Keep your distance and I will hear your words.
I tolerate your kind, vampire. Don't mistake that for friendship.
We can speak dark one, but - then you should leave.
All right, dark one - you have my attention. But don't push your luck.
Ha! You're even paler than me, vampire.
Say your piece, dark one. Then be on your way.
Evaded the Ordinators, have you vampire? What do you want with me?
It's dangerous for you to stay here too long, vampire.
If you can control your dark hunger, I will hear you out.
Most curious. A vampire in Morrowind - I think we have much we could learn from each other.
The blank eyes of a vampire. You never quite get used to it.
Very well, vampire. You've got my curiosity.
It's not every day I get to speak with one of your kind.
I've heard the stories, of course. But to meet a nightwalker in person? Very interesting.
A vampire? That's something you don't see every day. Or should I say every night.
A vampire walks in Morrowind - and still alive. After a fashion.
A vampire alive and well in Morrowind? Most interesting.
I see the Ordinators didn't burn every vampire at the stake after all. How interesting.
Not all vampires have been hunted to extinction, it seems. Most interesting.
You won't find me easy prey, vampire.
Get back to the foul darkness that spawned you, vampire!
Slink back to your lair, vampire - you don't scare me.
You think you frighten me, vampire? But you don't.
You so much as bare your fangs at me... and I'll put you back in the grave.
Begone, vampire. Even your dark powers are no match for me.
Huh - come, dark one. Try to take my blood and I'll wring ya pale neck.
Try to draw my blood and I'll snap your fangs off.
You don't want this fight vampire - I'm not weak like the others.
I swear vampire - you cross me, and I'll put you back in the grave for good.
Challenging me would be the biggest mistake of your foul existance, vampire.
Begone vampire - your foul presence offends me.
Begone you foul fiend!
I don't fear you, vampire. Leave, before something bad happens to you.
You think me prey, vampire? But you are mistaken.
Bloodless. Scentless. You do not scare us.
Vampire! I curse you in Almsivi's name, and in the name of all the ancestors. Return to the foul corruption from which you came!
Go away diseased creature!
Get away! Before you infect me.
Get away before you infect me.
Urgh, I took you for a corpse. Get away from me with that disease!
Do you want to infect us all - go away!
Get out of here - what are you trying to do, make me sick?
Oh that's some infection you have there!
Are you a player of the game? Or one of the game pieces?
Dance with your partner! Swing the axe and mace!
I take precautions to ensure that I am not found easily... I see I will have to take more precautions.
So you've found me again? Easier than the first time, eh?
I was worried they'd eat all of my pillows. You like pillows, don't you?
A visitor! And an outlander, too. What brings you to Nerano Manor?
Meow...
Oh...um...hello...hi...that is...nice to know...um...meet you. For a second I...I thought you were the courier...
I prayed to Zenithar for Divine Intervention. And here you are.
I prayed to Mara for Divine Intervention. You must have been sent in answer to my prayers.
Whenever you wish to return to Vivec, just let me know.

Take the stone pathway north from the docks and the path uphill. The entrance is hidden by a magical shield. Wait or rest at the head of the path, and the portal will open at dusk and dawn only, the magical twilight hours sacred to Azura.
Hello there. I'm Vevrana Aryon, a monk of Holamayan.
You got me this far. I can swim the rest of the way to Gnaar Mok once I've rested a bit. From there I'm taking the first ship back to Hammerfell.
Are you here to rescue me?
Thank you for curing me, friend.
You have dealt with my captors.Thank you. I will find my own way back to the Erabinimsun and continue to teach them of the Empire and its ways.
Hail the conquering hero! Hail, Nerevarine! We're all proud of you, sera, and many thanks for all you've done.
I will leave here soon. You are the new Grandmaster of the Morag Tong. Always watch for the Dark Brotherhood, for I am sure they will soon try to regain what you have taken from them here.
Well? Will Movis Darys join us?
Well, little spider. Have you killed Feruren Oran? Are you ready to join the Morag Tong?
So. You have found me. If you wish, you may request to join the Morag Tong.
You have honorably executed Mistress Therana, a most dangerous foe. I am impressed, Grandmaster. Our Hlaalu client will be pleased.
Mistress Therana is a dangerous and unstable Telvanni wizard. Go to the tower of Tel Branora and end her insanity.
You found and honorably executed Dram Bero, Grandmaster. Your work is excellent as always.
Dram Bero is a very secretive man who lives somewhere in Vivec City. Show him that he cannot hide from the Morag Tong.
Baladas Demnevanni may be found in his tower, Arvs Drelen, near Gnisis. I have heard that he is quite formidable, but surely not a match for your skills.
Excellent work, Grandmaster. I heard how cleverly you killed Larrius Varro. As you are the executioner of the Writ, the full payment must go to you.
With the recent troubles, we have had many Writs issued. One of the most challenging is for Larrius Varro in Fort Moonmoth near Balmora.
Orvas Dren's men, the Ienith brothers, must both be executed.
Brilnosu Llarys consorts with Daedra and outlaws at the Dunmer stronghold of Hlormaren which is on the coast west of Balmora, north of Hla Oad.
So Mathyn Bemis is dead. I trust he gave you no trouble? Good. I have your payment.
Mathyn Bemis may be found in the Ancestral Vaults in the Hlaalu Canalworks. He is head of an outlaw gang who will defend him from Morag Tong justice. Swiftness and accuracy to you.
Tirer Belvayn may be found in Shara, which is on the southwest coast of Sheogorad.
You have honorably executed Mavon Drenim. Approach and take the payment and credit.
Mavon Drenim may be found in the Telvanni tower in the Plaza of the Telvanni Compound in Vivec. Mephala guide your hand.
Galasa Uvayn offended a Redoran Lord. The Morag Tong will deliver justice.
Guril Retheran's family is influential in House Redoran, and this may have consequences. But the Writ is genuine and you executed it with honor.
I heard how you bought justice to Ethal Seloth and Idroso Vendu. You deserve the payment and honor of this Writ.
Ethal Seloth and Idroso Vendu are murderers, but they are also Telvanni. The Duke will do nothing. The Morag Tong is being paid well by their victim's families to execute justice.
You have executed the writ on Sarayn Sadus. The payment and honor for this Writ is yours.
Sarayn Sadus is hiding with other outlaws in Zaintirari. This is near the hut where you honorably murdered Odaishah Yasalmibaal.
You have claimed and executed the writ on Toris Saren. I have your payment.
The Saren family is influential. Make sure his execution is swift and honorable.
I hear that Odaishah Yasalmibaal is dead. That is good.
Killing Odaishah should be simple. Tracking him down may prove tricky.
Are you here to see what writs are open?
What brings you to the Morag Tong?
May Mephala guide your hand.
Strike swift and true.
May you execute your writs with honor.

That bigmouth Varro over at Moonmoth Legion Fort says he's going to stop corruption. He doesn't know what he's talking about. What he calls corruption is just the routine greasing of the wheels of commerce.
I have no further tasks for you, I'm afraid. Did you have a question?
The Ascadian Isles is a good place to hunt netch. Balur Salvu says he sees wild bull netch around his place all the time.

The best place to hunt rats is in the underworks of any of Vivec's cantons. But please be careful. Sometimes bad things -- and bad people -- hide in the underworks. So don't go poking into anything you can't handle.
The Imperial Cult has permission from the plantation owners to gather corkbulb. So at least those vile slavers are doing something to help those in need.
The kwama worker is not aggressive, but the warrior and forager are another matter. Be careful with them.

I am ashamed to admit it, but I steal willow anther from the flowers growing around the house of Gurak gro-Bagrat.  A cleric stealing from criminals to aid the needy... perhaps I have been around Zenithar-worshippers too long.
Muck is a vital ingrediant used when brewing potions to cure all sorts of diseases. Abishpulu Shand, a farmer in Gnisis, has a muckspunge patch near his hut you will be permitted to harvest from.
Please, bring me marshmerrow so we can brew more healing potions. Balur Salvu, a farmer near Pelagiad, grows what we need.
Greetings! I am Synnolian Tunifus and I manage the lay healer volunteers for our cult.
You have exceeded our greatest expectations. I always suspected you would rise beyond your humble teachers.
You have exceeded our greatest expectations. I'm afraid we have no more tasks to challenge your remarkable abilities.
Your talents and temperaments are apparently not suited for soliciting donations.
Canctunian Ponius has not answered our letters of late. I fear his zeal for the Ashlander mission may be waning.
What stone-hearted golem would not donate to widows and orphans in such desperate need?
The fundraising dinner at Fort Moonmoth should be quite the event - so long as we can secure strong spirits to keep the conversation merry and loosen some purse-strings.
For our coming Harvest's End pageant, we need a red shirt with a black vest. Please visit clothiers and ask if they would donate such a shirt and vest to the cult.
The shrine at Buckmoth Legion Fort has experienced an unfortunate shortfall in alms for the poor, and funds are urgently needed to purchase food and blankets for orphans and indigents.
Go ask the Argonian Mission in Ebonheart for alms for the poor. Their province is not so rich as Skyrim, but they are a generous and civic-minded people, despite what some of the locals may think.
We have so many projects, and so little gold. Go ask the Skyrim Mission in Ebonheart for alms for the poor. They should give generously.
I am Iulus Truptor. I manage the volunteer almoners for our cult. If you are ready to accept a fund raising project as an almoner, let me know.
By killing Carecalmo and Meryaran you have avenged the deaths of the healer Urjorad and his master Dro'farahn Stiff-Neck, and rid the world of a great evil.

When Talos Stormcrown was a young man in Skyrim, he went in to the mountains to learn the secrets of the Greybeards. He learned the secrets of the high peak winds, the roar of the winter blast, and the warm silk of the summer updrafts. When he descended from the mountains, he came riding the clouds, striding through the air in great boots he claimed were the gifts of the Greybeards for his cunning craft.

I can detect no trace of any evil curse upon Skull-Crusher. Perhaps it is only a legend. Perhaps it is a blessing, and not a curse, that preserves it from thieves. And perhaps we can perceive the hidden motions of the gods in all of this.

Stendarr has shown me a vision of Hilbongard's forge -- a Daedric ruin with a forge of molten stone at its heart. But fate has sealed this Daedric ruin forever from the world above by a colossal rockfall. Yet there is another way into the forge - through the Halls of the Dead.

Carecalmo is a very old High Elf wizard. As a young mage he served Uriel V, though he did not follow him to Akavir. He was accounted among the wise and powerful until he was implicated in Jagar Tharn's plot to place an impostor on the Imperial throne.

The Evil Archmage Almion Celmo of the Summerset Isles created the blade for a warrior, Thurgnarr Assi, who was to assassinate a king. When the assassination failed, Thurgnarr was slain, and the blade was lost.
Through the doors of Berandas, within the silent caverns, beneath the wings of twilight, dust sleeps in the shoes that Talos wore.

I have seen a Ring in Darkness. I have seen the Ring of the Wind, a legendary treasure of Elsweyr, sacred to Kynareth. I have seen the wind upon a dark elf's hand. I have seen the fire gleam upon a Dwarf's face. I have seen darkness on a ring of water. I have heard no name whispered in the mouth of stone.

I have the gift of Seeing, but not the gift of Doing. If you are bold, a doer of deeds, I beg you -- dedicate yourself to the Oracle's Quests, and I promise your rewards shall be great in the sight of the Nine.
I am an Oracle of the Imperial Cult. Sometimes I am even blessed to be granted visions.
The Devil is dead and the Blight is gone! You have succeeded where even Lord Vivec could not. I am so very proud this day. Your deeds do House Redoran great honor, Nerevarine. Great honor indeed.
You are now Archmaster of House Redoran. May the Tribunal guide you to use your position wisely.
You have won the duel against Bolvyn Venim! You are now the Archmaster of House Redoran. May Vivec guide you to glory.

Bolvyn Venim brought House Redoran back from the brink of defeat... Alas, no man is perfect. He kidnapped my son. He is harsh on his servants, and there are other crimes I am honor-bound to keep secret. I believe you would make a better Archmaster - you temper your strength with mercy.
Have you found a solution to the madness of Arethan Mandas? I would prefer he be cured, and not by the sword.
The Mad Lord has a few loyal followers and some outlaws have joined his 'estate.' They will protect him with their lives.
Do you have any word on the smugglers in Shurinbaal?
I believe the smugglers have a local contact somewhere here in Ald'ruhn. It may be worth your time to investigate here as well.
While I do not approve of all the Archmaster does, as a Councilman of House Redoran I cannot let this accusation stand.
Varvur Sarethi has been accused of the foul murder of Bralen Carvaren.
Find my son and bring him back to me. Once you and Varvur leave Venim Manor, you will be safe and no one will follow you.
I am in your debt. I will do what I can to return the favor. For now, tell Neminda that I am safe.
You're here to guard me? Thank the Tribunal! The assassins have already taken my guards. I fear there will be more.
I am Athyn Sarethi, a councillor of House Redoran. What can I do for you?
I am glad to see you again. I may have duties for you.
What brings you to my home again?
I'm proud of you, my protege. Only a sorcerer of great power and cunning could have defeated Dagoth Ur.
I'll tell you plainly. I've gained much by placing my protege as Archmagister in the House. I say this to you so you won't think I'm trying to trick you, or eventually take your place.
What brings the Archmagister here? I am pleased to see my own protege rise so quickly in House Telvanni.
You are now a Magister in House Telvanni. You must defeat Archmagister Gothren. Strike first before he sends agents to remove you from the stage.
The Redoran Stronghold of Indarys Manor also deserves a visit from House Telvanni. Retire the young Redoran noble Banden Indarys and report back to me when it is done.
The other Great Houses have also built strongholds without the Duke's charter. Go to Rethan Manor and retire the Hlaalu noble Raynasa Rethan.
I have heard of a promising Telvanni in Balmora who might agree to be your Mouth. Have you met with him?
Do we have enough support to overturn the Mages Guild monopoly?
Do you have news from Odirniran? Does Milyn Faram still live?
I am Master Aryon of House Telvanni - what brings you here?
Have you bought me a Daedra skin? I will pay you three-hundred drakes for it.
What brings you to Tel Vos?
Thank you for your help. I'll tell everyone how kind and brave you've been.
Please get him out of my house - he's scaring me.
You are the Nerevarine? But you are an outlander, how can that be? Such wonders in the world. Before I was a slave. Now I am the companion of the Nerevarine, and the bride of a Zainab chief!
Yes, thank you sera. He's a very fine man and I'm very happy.
I got that squeeze-butt Angaredhel pretty good, huh? But don't worry, the ghost won't be coming back.
All I ask is to die like a warrior - but how can that be?
You! Stranger! Please, can you help me? While travelling with my wife, we were set upon by a pack of wild nix-hounds.
Welcome outlander, to the festival slave market - the finest slaves in Vvardenfell. I'm Savile Imayn, and I know we have the slave for you.
Are you looking for standard household slaves - or are you looking for something special?
Hello, my dear. Nels Llendo, at your service.
I'll be out soon enough - and I won't be poaching the puzzle-canal pilgrims again, that's for sure.
Damn fool meddling priests! I wouldn't have touched her if she hadn't come on to me like a hot sow. Bastards! Get my hands on one I'm going to squeeze him like a pimple.
Nuffin t'do w'me mate. Ain't shiftin. Did the crime, n'doin' me time.
I'm in here for some sort of blasphemy or something. Did it, all right. Guild says serve your time and keep your yap shut. So I'm being a good boy and staying quiet.
Please, can you help me - my wife has been taken by cultists!
Greetings. You should take care while in these parts. There are murderous outlaws about - no telling what might happen to an unwary traveller like yourself.
I'm innocent - I was framed!
Stay out of things that don't concern you, outlander. This affair is between myself and Therana. I want no help. I'll tolerate no interferance.
You've got to read this leaflet, friend - especially if you're shopping for ingredients.
Welcome to my shop, stranger. It's good to see paying customers, especially with all the competition these days.
Excuse me, can you help me? I'm over here. My name is Cassius Olcinius. Sorry...you see, I've been made invisible by a wizard!
Welcome, friend. It is good to see a customer in the store. That annoying fool outside chases them away.
I am Ilmeni Dren, daughter of the Duke. Who are you and what are you doing here?
I am Brara Morvayn, a councillor of House Redoran. Is there something I can do for you?
Please, whoever you are! Kill the scamp before it causes any more trouble.
Are you the one who can escort me to the docks? I had in run in with some Telvanni thugs last night - I just want to get out of here.
Tell my father that I have escaped. Now Neloth will no longer be able to influence him.
Please help me! I am being held hostage by Master Neloth. If you can get me out of here and we travel together to the Telvanni docks, my father will reward you.

Poor daughter. Dead now, all dead. Oblivion deadens us each and every one. One mistake stakes like cake crusts stalks you forever ever more. Blood? Yes, your blood. Daughter's blood. Poor Delyna. All over you. On your hands. Your pretty hands. Sheogorath whispers! Yes, I see it now! The sin on your face! Filthy! Worthless!
Pots and pans and bottles and cans. Furniture for my furniture. The trees have her. Fear's tower. Flowers and trees and birds and bees and for eyes myself invite.
My gems are gone, my heart unguarded. These guards can't find my butterfly. Oh, madness! To thy breast I cling, suckling!
Good luck on the mountain. Go with Kynareth. And don't forget my old lucky coin, eh?
Right. I'm Wulf, like I said. I was wondering what you were doing here in Ghostgate?
I'm glad you found my master's murderer. I'm staying here until all his accounts are settled.
My name is Vala Catraso, and I run a little class for outlanders new to Morrowind. You may find it easier to get along here if you know a little about the history of the land.
Are you hoping to study a little Morrowind history with the rest of the class?

Please. Llaren Terano is a terrible sorcerer and worshipper of Molag Bal. He stripped me and made me his prisoner - that's all I can remember. If you can recover my ring from that monster, I can use its enchantments to escape.
I'd love to sell you my wares, but I've got a corprus stalker on the loose.
Hello there. I am Llirala, the caretaker of the Sanctus Shrine. What brings you all the way out here?

I am Cunius Pelelius, a principal and charter-holder of the Caldera Mining Company. I cannot imagine why someone like you should think you have business with me, but I will listen, if you can be brief and polite.
Outlander! Would you like to earn some gold? Then take care of Trerayna Dalen for me. She's a petty annoyance, but Mistress Therana won't let me leave the tower to take care of her.
I'm just a netch herder. It's long hours, but easy work. Just keep them from wandering off.
Just a friendly warning - don't spook the netch.
Leave the netch alone, and they'll leave you alone too.

Welcome to the Sadrith Mora temple outlander. You'll have to excuse the improvised furnishing - Telvanni hospitality, you see. But I assure you, there's nothing second-class about our committment to Almsivi, or our committment to faith and service.

Welcome to our little Almsivi chapel. Pardon our informal surroundings, but we are guests here of House Telvanni. And apparently they have no more spacious, well-lit accomodations for the Temple faithful. Still, we have all the services you would expect to find at a much larger temple.
You can look, but don't touch. Yes, it's all Dwarf-make, and it belongs to Master Aryon - so keep your hands to yourself.

I'm Turedas, chief of Master Aryon's mercenary guard. Providing for the prosperity of Tel Vos and the village is my trade. And, from the looks of you, adventuring is yours. If you are an adventurer, would you be interested in a little work?
Greetings, sera. I have stylish clothes for any pocketbook. Shall I tell you about my trade? Or would you be interested in a little work?
Good day, my friend. I am Bivale Teneran. I flatter myself that I am the finest clothier in these parts. Shall I tell you about my trade? Or would you be interested in a little work?

Your bravery in helping those in chains is impressive indeed. There are others like you and I out there in Morrowind. If you are ever asked - 'Have you seen the Twin Lamps?' You say in return - 'They light the way to freedom'.
Reeh-jah will be safe here. Thank you for risking your life to save his.
Rabinna will be safe here. We will give her the medical attention she needs.
My husband Drerel is dead? No! I can't speak about this anymore...
You there! Yes, you - I'm in need of an escort. You'll do in a pinch.
I thought I heard someone... I suppose you're here to loot? This is my own family's tomb, but... I'd be willing to let you take a few things if you help me find my father's amulet.
Hey, there, kipper? Why don't you buy an old reaver a jug of mazte, and I'll tell you a little secret?
Take care, traveller, there are thieving Ashlanders about. A couple of them just robbed me of my guar hide shipment bound for Tel Aruhn.
W-who are you? You go now! Leave me alone. I must get home now.
My name is Hannat Zainsubani. I entered this cavern seeking shelter from the weather, and these madmen stripped me and imprisoned me here.
What brings the Archmaster all the way out here?
What brings you back to Ald Velothi?
Good! You back! You got a note from Bashuk?
Hey, you got my note! So go! Don't want to stay out here all day. No fun to sleep on rocks.
Hey, you! You're not one of them townbosses, right? How about you help me!
Please. I am afraid. Do not tell - I'm hiding.

Please, have mercy. I was the sorcerer on this job, but the ogrim got out of control, and the scamps slaughtered my companions and served them to me in a broth. And stripped me. And made me wear this outfit. Help me out of here - please!
I'm Larrius Varo, Legion Champion of Fort Moonmoth. I've been hoping you might come by.
So. It turns out the Nerevarine is an outlander after all. And from what I hear, being Nerevarine was no picnic for you. Well done.
The bad people I was talking about? What do you know - they're all good people now. I think you may have had something to do with that.
I don't know their names. But maybe you can find their names. And... where to find them. And then maybe my story could have a happy ending.
You're Thieves Guild, right? Might you help a brother in need?
You wouldn't by any chance be heading toward Ald'ruhn, would you? Maybe you could do me a favor.
Thank you for ridding me of that ghost. Since it's not a haunted house any more, now maybe I can get some sleep.
The Imperial cult said they'd send someone to take care of the ghost. I suspect it has to do with the trap door.
I'm afraid my travels will have to continue without dear Edras. It will simply not be the same.
For bringing me to this place, I thank you. It has been a thorn in the side of the Camonna Tong for too long. Go now. I have no further business with you.
Excuse me, can you help me...please? I fear I am lost without your help. Please, can you aid a poor Argonian?
Aaaah.. my axe! It will be good to cleave some skulls once again!
It's good to have my jewelry back. Thank you, friend.
That scoundrel Dro'Zhirr has my family heirlooms, and I want them back. If you can return them to me, I'd gladly pay you their weight in gold.
Hello, stranger. What? What the hell are you looking at? Get the hell out of here before I take your head off! All I want to do is catch some slaughterfish. Is that so wrong?
Hell friend. I feel much better now. Things aren't as muddled.
Ah...hello there. I was hoping a handsome young stranger like yourself would happen by. Might you take a moment to help a lady in distress?
Hrelvesuu is vanquished, yet somehow I feel uneasy. I must investigate these ruins further. You have been a worthy companion. Farewell my friend.
Ho there! You're one of Hrundi's band, aren't you? I can spot you a mile off.
Yes? What do you want? If you're looking to get out of Seyda Neen, I'd be happy to give you a little advice.
Thank you for getting them back. It's good to hear you were able to make those fetchers pay, as well.
Good to finally have them back. Don't know how I would have made it without them.
What can this poor merchant do for you? I've had very little business recently with the terrible haunting in my shop!
I've gotta get my stuff to Gnaar Mok.
I'm Master Gilvas Barelo, the abbot of Holamayan Monastery.
Yeah, they call me 'Fast' Eddie. Whaddya they call you?
Oh, just what I need. Another stupid Redoran.
You... The vision... The Moon-and-Star! It was you, not I. Forgive me, Nerevar, forgive me! I meant only to prepare the way.
I have seen the error of my ways. Your wisdom has guided me through this most disturbing time.
I know my destiny. I have seen the message in the dream. Have you not also experienced the waking dream?
Oh my sweet flower - you're hurt badly. Go see a healer and I... can kiss it better for you later.

Hello there dumpling. You're the belle of the ball, the toast of the city! So let down your hair, have a drink, shake those snug hips! And just remember, Uncle Crassius adored you before you became a big famous hero. Don't you be a stranger now!
Oh my sweet-pea! Grandmaster - now you've climbed since first we met. Don't be a stranger now you're big and important. You won't neglect poor, lonely Uncle Crassius, now will you?
You're a councillor now! I'm so happy for you - what an honor! But no more than you deserve, pumpkin. Don't neglect poor, lonely Uncle Crassius now, your devoted admirer.
I don't have any more business for you, dumpling, but thanks for coming to see poor, lonely Uncle Crassius all the same.
Oooh, tell me - did you teach Banden Indarys his lesson? Is House Redoran retreating with a smacked bottom?
Tell me pumpkin - did you find Reynel Uvirith?
Have you found Velfred the Outlaw? It shouldn't be too much of a challenge for someone of your talents, my darling.
I'm glad you stopped by, sweetie-pie. I may have some business to discuss with you.
Oooh yes, I see we're going to get along just splendidly, sweetie-pie. You'll go far with my support.
Come on, dumpling, don't be shy. Just do this one little favor for your Uncle Crassius.
Yes, I'm Crassius Curio. But you can call me Uncle Crassius.
Please, stay and take your time, my little flower. What is a little time between such intimate friends?
My name is Kaye, and I'm in charge of the volunteer shrine sergeants for the cult. Are you ready for an assignment?
Julielle Aumine can rest easy now her murder has been avenged. And a few less cut-throat smugglers in the world in no bad thing, either.

I believe our Oracle knew Linus Iulus was not equal to the task, though he begged for the quest, and that his death is a burden on her conscience. I hope returning the staff will help to ease that pain.

It's always good to see you, my friend. I have no further missions for you. Speak to Synnolian Tunifus or Iulus Truptor downstairs. I have also given your name to our Oracle here, Lalatia Varian. Her duties, should you undertake them, will be far more challenging.
Did you help Okur bring justice to this wronged spirit so it could be laid to rest?
Go to Hla Oad, and speak with Okur. When such a devout follower of the Nine senses sprits of the other world, we must answer their call.
Our oracle, Lalatia Varian, had a vision of a Silver Staff of Shaming, and Linus Iulus holding one of these staves. Not once have I found her holy sight to be mistaken!
Is the wicked creature dead?
We drove a coven of witches out from the old Daedric ruins of Ashalmawia. We thought we had destroyed them all - it seems we were mistaken.
Remember, only spells, enchanted weapons, or refined weapons like silver daggers can harm a ghost. Be careful out there.
Have you recovered our chapel limeware bowl?
The High Elves are a small, tight-knit community on Vvardenfell. Try asking other High Elves if they know Caryarel and where he lives.
I'm tall, and so are the tales people tell about me.
You can't spend loot if you're dead, my friend. Get yourself to a healer, we can talk shop later.
Those Camonna Tong thugs are going to get blasted right out of the door if they try their luck now.
Dinara Othrelas had better watch out. Looks like Fara's about to be the new queen of quince pastries.
Welcome back Nerevarine. And thank you for all you have done. Your name and deeds are on everyone's lips. So tell me... did you find much treasure on Red Mountain?
So the wet-ear has become the master. Nice work. Got any scores you want to cut me in on?
I don't have any jobs for you, my quick-fingered friend. Try Sugar-Lips in Balmora or Aengoth in Ald-Ruhn.
Faylan Marion is a powerful wizard, so getting hold of that Ebony Staff won't be easy. Do be careful.
Have you found the Redoran Cooking Secrets yet? Fara won't win the competition without it.
We need to protect ourselves from the Camonna Tong. Have you hired us a wizard yet?
Have you gotten a Grandmaster's Retort for me yet? They're a bit too pricey for most people, so I prefer to take the *special* discount.
We don't usually do business with the Mages Guild - but they want that recipe for a potion of dispel magic rather badly.
I'm Aengoth the Jeweller. It's a real pleasure to make your acquaintance.

All this Nerevar stuff... silly superstition, if you ask me. Maybe you got lucky? Maybe this Dagoth, such a poor old fellow, and so tired, he just falls down? All the stories I hear? Make you sound like some kind of hero or something.
So you're the Master Thief now, huh? Just don't forget your old pal Aengoth when you're spreading that loot around.
I got no jobs for you my friend. Try Sugar-Lips in Balmora or Big Helende in Sadrith Mora.
Well, have you been able to recover the Darts of Judgement?
The Darts of Judgement are very rare weapons made in my home province of Valenwood. The Guild will pay good money if you don't want them.
I still need scrap metal to fix the centurions. We're easier to spill than a baby's cup till they're up and running again.
We need four pieces of scrap metal to be on the safe side. You don't need to be a hero and clear out a Dwemer ruin, just run in, snatch some, and get out.
Have you returned with a copy of Withershins? You won't find it in any shops, if you catch my drift.
Like I said, I think Miles Gloriosus over in Maar Gan has a copy. I don't know where he keeps it, though.
Did you get that naughty little book for me my friend?
Apparently Gandosa Arobar has a copy of this naughty book, which has been banned by the Temple. Fetch the book and return it to me.
You've got that twinkle in your eye. Does that mean you have the Redoran Master helm?
Most of the Councilors in House Redoran have a Master Helm, but they can be hard to find.
You were sent to fetch Aneraron's Devil Tanto from the Guild of Mages. What happened?
You looking for jobs? I've got something that might add some clink to your pockets.
Loot and luck for us all, Master Thief.
It is important we defend the South Wall. Who is the master of security?
Where are the Dwemer Artifacts Habasi asked you to get?
What Ahnassi has is yours. There should be plenty of food and drink downstairs, and a comfortable bed. You want the robe from Ahnassi's shoulders? All you need to do is ask.
Ahnassi greets you, with very great pleasure. And Ahnassi hopes you will come to her for training. Ahnassi thinks she would enjoy wrestling with you. Don't you think?

What Khajiit can see what she wants, and not take it? Could Ahnassi ask for gift? Don't say 'No' to Ahnassi. Must Ahnassi be the thief?. Must she steal this thing, this fellow she wants? Or will he give himself as a gift?
Ah, it is Ahnassi's VERY special friend. Ahnassi welcomes you to the hospitality of her house.
Ah, it is Ahnassi's true and good friend. Ahnassi can never see enough of her good friend.
Yes, please, it is Ahnassi's new friend. So pleased to see you!
Rrrrr. When Ahnassi sees smooth moves like this, Ahnassi thinks a dancer. No? A high wall walker? If you aren't in the Thieves Guild, perhaps you should be.
Step right up, friend, and look over my collection of scrolls. How about the flashy and cheap Taldam's Scorcher to burn your foes? Or Ondusi's Unhinging to open stuck chests and doors?
You helped Ajira, but I cannot blame you. I should have made you a better offer.
Are you here for scrolls or some other enchantments? Perhaps soulgems? Whatever your enchanting needs, you've come to the right place.
I cannot think with all these interruptions - please, leave me alone!
What? Are you deaf? No interruptions, I can't think!
Welcome, adventurer. Looking for an Equalizer? Something to give you an edge against a superior opponent?
When you need to do a lot of damage in a hurry, you can't beat a poisoned blade. Try my inexpensive Iron Spider Dagger, or an Imperial Netch Blade for even more bite.
You killed the little runt? I don't know what you were thinking - he was a source of good income for me. If anyone asks, I don't know you.
Good that you found that for me, friend. I'll make that little fetcher pay for lying to me. Although, I've got to be honest, it is kind of fun messing with the little guy.
I know the little fetcher's got a hiding place somewhere in town. Just not sure where yet.
When you came to Vvardenfell, you were just a wet-behind-the-ears outlander. And now you're the Nerevarine, and Morrowind's biggest hero. Well, it's an honor to know you.
Are you the one that boat dropped off? Odd to see a boat arrive at that time of the day.
You won't believe this, but I got my family ring stolen all over again! Just my rotten luck, I guess.
Thanks again for returning my family ring.
Ra'virr knows why you are here. You want to buy Ra'virr's famous Daedric weapons!
Ra'virr buys magic weapons direct from the Telvanni. You'll not find any cheaper in all Balmora.
Jobasha reads books, buys books, sells books. What more can Jobasha say? Jobasha knows a little about everything - so you ask, and maybe Jobasha will talk.
Welcome to Arrille's Tradehouse. I'm Arrille, publican and proprietor. You're a new face here, so if you want a little advice -- free to new customers -- just ask.
I barter for goods or coin - I also have a small selection of spells for sale. You want a little advice? That's free. That's ALL that's free.

Now you are a part of history, Nerevarine. It is an honor to know you. And yet, there is still the mystery. Does the hero shape the times, or do the times shape the hero? Perhaps you should write a history book, eh?
So? Have you done that little favor I asked?
I'm Hasphat, Drillmaster for the Fighters Guild. I offer training to the public, and, at a considerable discount, to members of the Guild.
You're new here, aren't you? My name is Uupse. I take care of the corprus victims in the Corprusarium
Make yourself at home, I have some things to do.
I'm Beyte Fyr, the wife of Divayth Fyr. One of them, at least. Also daughter - it's complicated, all right?
Divayth Fyr is who you want to see, not me.
My name is Delte Fyr. Did you want to see Divayth Fyr? Have you got corprus disease - or are you another questing hero looking to plunder the dungeon?

I am Vistha-Kai, Warden of the Corprusarium. I am here to warn you: do not harm the inmates. If you come to plunder the dungeon, you must endure their attacks, or take your chances with me, their Warden and Protector.
You have been warned. Do not harm the inmates of the Corprusarium. If you plan to plunder the dungeon, you must endure their attacks, or you will surely die to mine.
You get a taste of home when you get a taste o' Runa.
Bet they don't have girls like me where you're from - ain't that right outlander?
S'fine place this is, huh? S'fine place. Good place for me to jusht forget about my troubles.
Ssshtupid slaves. Why they gotta run? Huh? Sure, be nothing to do if they didn't. But why the gotta hide, too?
Looking's for free, outlander.
Oh no, not another Khajiit! I'm still smarting from the last one.
An Argonian! How exciting. I've never had an Argonian, um, customer.
Hello there handsome. Looking for a good time?
Between you and me, I always rest here between pilgrimages.
Runa's a real gem, ain't she?
Welcome to my house, friend. Make yourself at home.
Crassius Curio can be very eccentric at times. But his weaknesses allow him to be manipulated.

You've got to hand it to the daemon-charmers - they surprised us. The Telvanni have these little groups squatting down all over the island - and we've done little to stop them. They're going to be tough to root out. It's going to cost money and lives - but we'd better make the investment now, before it's too late.
Welcome Grandmaster. How may we be of service?
I admire your dedication, but you can't serve the clan if you're dead. Go see a healer and we'll speak when you've recovered.
Welcome councilman. Or rather, councilwoman. It is satisfying to see the subtler sex rise to power, don't you think?
Welcome councilman. Do you have business prospects you wish to discuss?
We've done good business together, but I have nothing more for you. Why not speak with Crassius Curio or Edryno Arethi?
Canctunian Ponius at the East Empire Company is threatening to buy ebony from House Redoran instead of us. We can't let that happen.
I heard Bolvyn Venim was having an affair with the wife of one of the other councillors. And they call the Redoran 'pious' and 'moral' - it's a bad joke.
Have you found the murderer of Ralen Hlaalo? We can't allow nobility of the clan to be struck down without consequence.
I need you to solve the murder of Ralen Hlaalo.
We have ears and eyes everywhere, outlander. I want you to check in with a contact of mine.
Are the alchemists buying only from House Hlaalu's fine guar hides?
We need to improve House Hlaalu's share of the guar hide trade with the alchemists in Vivec.
I heard the queen was dead - oh, to be a muskfly on Avon Oran's wall this moment!
Is the queen in the Inanius eggmine dead?
I want you to put my rival out of business - I'll make it worth your time.
Let's get down to business. I need the Alchemical formulas of Aurane Frernis.
Do you have a copy of Neminda's orders? Remember the codephrase is "Orphan of Arnesia."
I am Nileno Dorvayn. I keep business here in Balmora going when the Hlaalu councilors are away - which is most of the time.
Welcome back, Patriarch. Come, sit with me and recite the sermons.
I have no more duties for you my child - but I am always here for guidance and council, should you require it.
Have you found the Crosier of Saint Llothis?
Did you find the Cleaver of Saint Felms the Bold?
Have you found Feril Salmyn? Or the Hair Shirt of Saint Aralor?
Well, my child. Were you able to cure Assantus Hansar?
Seven blessings, my child. I am Uvoo Llaren, the master of Ghostgate Temple.
What brings you to the Temple, my child? Have you been lax in your duties?
My duties are too sacred for anyone under the rank of Curate. Perform your duties and practice your skills. You are not ready yet.
I still remember my first pilgrimage to Maar Gan. Anhaedra threatened to tear out my entrails and play them like... harp strings! *chuckles* ... I was quite terrified.
Elvil Vidron will do pennance for his errors. But I am glad you did not kill him. I believe we must show mercy, even to heretics.
Ah. The new Archcanon. How may I be of service?
I have no more duties for you. Speak with Uvoo Llaren in Ghostgate or Endryn Llethan in Vivec. And...thank you, for all you have done.
Go to Hassour and bring the Tribunal's justice to the leader of this dark cult. Be warned, though, that Dagoth Fovon is a terrible foe. Many of the righteous have already fallen to him.
You made the Pilgrimage to Maar Gan? It sounds like you handled Anhaedra well.
Go to the shrine in Maar Gan. Read the inscription on the rock and imitate Vivec's actions.
We cannot have two Nerevarines. Go to Suran and prove to Elvil Vidron that you are the true Incarnate.
Clearly Elvil Vidron is a heretic. Convince him that he is mistaken or, if all else fails, prove it by killing him. If he is the true Nerevarine, he is protected by prophesy and cannot die.
Vivec often showed compassion to his enemies. You must show compassion by curing Bulfim gra-Shugarz, a Sheogorath worshipper in Maelkashishi.
You have slain Raxle Berne. Galom Daeus is now no longer a plague waiting to strike out upon the land.
Hmmm. An outlander as Archcanon will certainly raise some eyebrows among the faithful. But I find the possibilities for expanding our congregation beyond the Dunmer rather exciting.
I have given you the garb of one of the Temple's vampire hunters. When you are ready, slay the elder vampire Raxle Berne in the Dwemer stronghold of Galom Daeus.
Are you to serve the Temple by performing duties, my child? Or have you come for something else?
Speak with me again when you have gained the rank of Curate. I will have more dangerous duties for you then.
Go to Mawia, find Delvam Andarys, and make certain that this necromancer does not escape the justice of the Temple.
I heard you defeated the Daedra at Mount Kand in a contest of riddles and received Vivec's blessings. I celebrate your success. I have other duties for you when you are ready.
Go to Mount Kand and answer the Daedra's riddles. If you answer correctly, you do not have to fight them. This will test your cunning, not your swordarm.
So. Did you cure Lette?
The Temple does not proselytize, but we do good works for non-believers. Cure Lette of swamp fever and return to me.
A villager in Tel Mora has fallen ill, but there is no Temple in Tel Mora where she can go for healing.
I love Saryoni as a son does a father. But it's good to have an Archcanon of action leading the Temple. I feel in my bones there are dangerous days ahead.
I believe Archcanon Saryoni wishes to speak with you.
I heard Bjadmund is dead and the dark cult has been cleansed from the shrine of Ihinipalit. You have earned the respect of the Ancestors.

I know only that Ihinipalit is somewhere beneath the St. Delyn Canton. Go there with fire in your eyes and in your heart. Bring the Temple's justice to the leader of this cult, Bjadmund. I wish I could accompany you, but I am not the young witchhunter I once was.

In a dream, a priest had a vision of the Shoes of St. Rilms lying neglected in the depths of Ald Sotha, just northeast of Vivec. Go to Ald Sotha and, if this is a true vision, return this sacred relic to the Temple.
I see you have broken your oath of silence. How disappointing.
I've sworn you to silence. You may not speak again until you reach the Sanctus Shrine in Dagon Fel.

Try and convince her to go to the Corprusarium before she spreads the Divine Disease to others. She is very devout and would be most easily impressed by some show of your devotion to the Temple's teachings.
A well-loved pilgrim here in Vivec is spreading the Divine Disease to others. Someone must convince Tanusea Veloth to leave our holy city.

The Devil is dead, and the Blight is gone. Praise Almsivi, and bless you, Nerevarine. It is strange, however. that I have not heard from Lord Vivec. From time to time he does disappear, for reasons of his own, but it seems odd that he should be absent now in the moment of his triumph.
Thank you for coming. You know the Temple's doctrine on the Nerevarine. Perhaps it is time to change that doctrine.
You are the new Patriarch. Congratulations. I have long wanted to retire from the politics of the Temple and write another book of sermons.

I am old and will soon retire. Even though you are an outlander, you are one of our most promising priests. If you want to replace me as Archcanon of the Temple, you must complete the Pilgrimages of the Four Corners.
Are you here to request an audience?
The Deathshead garrison is at your disposal, sir.
You can't serve the Emperor if you're dead, soldier. Get yourself healed - that's an order.
I don't have any more orders for you. Check with the Knight-Protectors in each of the forts.
Is there a conspiracy brewing involving the Talos Cult? I worry our time is short.
Well, trooper? What's your report on Ragash gra-Shuzgub?
At ease - have you dealt with the Gnisis Eggmine?
Find Lugrub gro-Odgum and kill him. Only then will justice be served.
Give me a report on the land deed, soldier.
I'm Darius, commander of the Deathshead garrison. I reckon you got what we need here at the Imperial Legion - looking to join up?
My son is dead - let me grieve in peace!
You have done everything I would ask and more. My thanks, outlander.
Were you able to get Giras Indaram to pay his debt to me?

Giras Indaram owes me for several repairs to his armor. I have asked him to pay the debt he owes, but he refuses. And I cannot seek redress from a Councilman, since Giras' brothers are among the most respected Buoyant Armigers.
Oh please tell me - did my son arrive safely at the Koal Cave?
My son Deval wants to make the Ruddy-Man Pilgrimage. A noble aim, but it's dangerous journey.
I am Tuveso Beleth, and this is my son, Deval.
I'd rather die than lose my position as a Knight of the Imperial Dragon. Meet me in the Arena for a duel to the death!
There can only be one Knight of the Imperial Dragon on Vvardenfell. To take my place, you must defeat me in an honourable duel.
You have returned the Lord's Mail. Now you must find the Paladin's blade, Chrysamere.
I am Varus Vantinius, the Knight of the Imperial Dragon. That makes me the head of the Imperial Legion here in Vvardenfell.
Talk to Frald the While here in Ebonheart for your orders. Perhaps we can speak again if you attain the rank of Knight Protector.
Are you checking in on Buckmoth Legion fort sir? Security is tight as a guar-drum, I promise.
I have no more orders for you. Check with the Knight-Protectors at the other Legion forts.
Have you stolen a glove and stopped a scandal, soldier?
What's the situation with Drinar Varyon? Have you found Dwemer artifacts at his house?
I don't think we've been introduced, outlander. I'm Imsin the Dreamer, Knight-Protector of this fort.
The spirit of Irer Nervion and his ancestors will rest peacefully knowing they have been avenged by you.
Now the Telvanni and Hlaalu will think twice before expanding so rashly beyond their assigned territory.
The new Archmaster - to what do we owe the honor?
I admire your dedication, but you can't serve the clan if you're dead. Go see a healer and we can speak when you've recovered.
You have performed all the duties I have, my friend.
Have you slain Raynasa, the lord of Rethan Manor?
Have you slain Reynel, the wizard of Tel Uvirith?
Have you slain the foul beast known as Dagoth Tanis?
A Buoyant Armiger named Irer Nervion is missing, perhaps slain, at the hand of a foul creature calling itself Dagoth Tanis.
What can I for you? Are you interested in duties for House Redoran? I may have a few.
I have further duties, but they are too dangerous for someone of your rank. Come back when you are a House Brother.
Did you convince Rothis Nethan to appear for the duel? This craven has already cost the honor of House Redoran too much.
Tell me - do you have the treasures of the Redas Tomb?
Welcome outlander. I am Faral Retheran, the House Redoran steward here.
You have performed all my duties honorably. But I have one more thing to ask of you.
Minabibi has already answered many of my questions. We have much to learn from each other.
Galur Rithari's account is most interesting. Perhaps you should travel to the shrine of Bal Ur yourself, one day.
How does it feel to be so loved by the Dunmer, Archmage? They are not an easy people to win the respect of, but you have more than earned it. I hope you can enjoy this happy hour while it lasts.
Please, my friend. I cannot in all good conscience speak of duties when you are so close to death.
You have done well. When you are a Master-Wizard of the Guild, we should speak again.
These papers allegedly describe how an Ordinator from Bal Ur became a vampire and was cured. I would be most interested in a copy of this book.
Once I have the soul of an ash ghoul to study, we can learn how to better fight this dark cult.
Have you found the soul of an ash ghoul?
While killing is never pleasant, it is sometimes necessary. Go to Shal and put a stop to Telura Ulver's necromancy.
Thank you, my friend. Minabibi has already answered many of my questions.
Were you able to arrange a meeting with a wise woman of the Ashlanders?
From what I've heard, I doubt the Erabenimsun or the Urshilaku would agree. The Zainab might agree, but I would speak with the Ahemmusa first.
I fear it may take weeks or even months to find a copy.
Tenyeminwe is staying at Muriel's Cornerclub, just over the bridge from the castle. Get her to the Elf-Skerring in the docks, before the Telvanni cause her any trouble.
Welcome, smoothskin. I am Skink-in-trees-shade, the Mages Guild steward here. But you can call me Skink, if that's too much to remember.
Welcome, marshsister. I am Skink-in-trees-shade, the Mages Guild steward here. Come, stay a while and tell me the news from Black Marsh.
Welcome, marshbrother. I am Skink-in-trees-shade, the Mages Guild steward here. Come, stay a while and tell me the news from Black Marsh.
I am at your service. Are you here for duties or advancement?
I may have duties for you later. Right now I am busy making a Detect Creatures potion for Edwinna in Ald-Ruhn.
You're the one who slew my brother, Sjoring. I claim no vengeance on his behalf. He had a violent heart, and met a violent end - that's all that needs to be said.
Knight of the Imperial Dragon - I'm at your service.
Give me your report on Sorkvild the Raven.
There's a necromancer up near Dagon Fel who calls himself Sorkvild the Raven. I want his wings clipped.
A pair of breeding netches are threatening Gnaar Mok. They're dangerous when they're in heat - just like the local women.
Bandits holed up in Gnaar Mok have captured an Imperial citizen and are demanding ransom. We'll send them steel, not septims.
At ease, soldier. Report on Jocien Ancois.
I need a good soldier to rescue the hermit Jocien Ancois.
The Buoyant Armigers have challenged us to a hunt.
I don't think we've been introduced outlander. I'm Radd Hard-Heart. How can I help you?
You lost the challenge with the best of the Bouyant Armigers. But at least you had the courage to try.
Ha! You won the duel of courtesy. Perhaps the Armigers won't be so quick to judge us from now on.
You fought a duel with Varus Vantinius and emerged the victor. I salute you, Knight of the Imperial Dragon.
Saprius is safe for now. In a few days, he'll be on his way to Cyrodiil.
Report on Saprius Entius soldier. We can't let the ordinators find him first.
A member of our order is a murderer! Find Saprius Entius before the ordinators do and bring him back to me.
Have you put a stop to the slanders of Suryn Athones?
An Ordinator has been spreading lies about the order of Ebonheart. I need you to stop Suryn Athones' slanders.
Deserting the Legion is crime enough. But when a deserter takes up with Daedra worshippers, we must act.

The Bouyant Armigers claim we have no courtesy. Here in Morrowind, that means wit, poetry, sophistication. In short, we are not gentleman, and if we are not gentlemen, then we are not fit to serve as protectors of this land.
Good-day, citizen. I'm Frald the White, Knight-Protector of the Imperial Legion.
Blessings of the Nine, citizen. Always happy to share some Morrowind lore with visitors to our province.
Teleportation is the only civilised way to travel.
Nothing gets you there faster than magic.
Why walk when I can guide?
To be honest, killing Therana was an act of mercy - how I loathed serving that deranged old hag. Ah, apologies Archmagister. What did you need from me?
Let no new thing arise, Archmagister. Your own magnificant ascent through our ranks excepted, of course.
Tel Branora is Therana's tower. It's near the southeast tip of Azura's Coast on an island. My mistress can be... eccentric at times. Try not to agitate her.
I don't have any chores for you. Speak with the other mouths instead. Or you could speak with Mistress Therana again - though I would not reccomend it.
Outlander, you stand before Felisa Ulessen, the Mouth for Mistress Therana. Weigh your words carefully.
Ah... Archmagister. Neloth is no longer with us... he must have displeased you greatly. I hope you find my service more to your liking.
Greetings Archmagister. Master Neloth lives in the tower of Tel Naga here in Sadrith Mora if you have business to discuss with him. Or I can deliver your message myself if you wish.
Skink-In-Trees-Shade seems like a decent sort... for an Argonian. But he has an unhealthy interest in vampires.
Master Neloth lives in the tower of Tel Naga here in Sadrith Mora if you have business to discuss.
I have no more chores for you, outlander. Did you want to discuss something else?
Master Neloth will want the Staff of the Silver Dawn soon.
I am Arara Uvulas, the Mouth of Master Neloth. What do you wish to discuss?
Welcome, Archmagister. If I may be so bold, although others may see an outlander leading our house as peverse, I believe might makes right.
If you have personal business with Mistress Dratha, you may find her in Tel Mora. But be warned - she doesn't like men. At all. So I would advise against it.
If you have personal business with Mistress Dratha, you may find her in Tel Mora.
If you want more chores, speak with the other mouths.
Have you found the ring of the Black Jinx? Mistress Dratha is not known for her patience.
Surely someone here in Sadrith Mora has heard of it. Acquire the Black Jinx and deliver it to me.
Well? Do you have the muck?
Many alchemists sell it - or you can gather it yourself from mucksponge like a grubby slave. I don't care which.
I am Raven Omayn, mouth of Mistress Dratha.
Archmagister Gothren watches your rapid advance in House Telvanni with great interest, outlander.
Archmagister Gothren is my patron. If you have business with him, you may find him in Tel Aruhn.
This Dwemer ruin lies west of the town of Vos. Apparently these ruins are what Archmagister Gothren wanted Ainat Sanababi to look for.

Baladas Demnevanni lives in Arvs Drelen which is in Gnisis. Go there and ask him about the Disappearance of the Dwarves, Dwemer artifacts, and the Dwemer language. You do not have to get an answer from him, simply asking the three questions is enough.
I am Mallam Ryon, the mouth of Archmagister Gothren.

My patron, Master Aryon, is quite open-minded. You might ask him to sponsor you as your patron. If he agrees, I can stop being Aryon's Mouth here on the council. Perhaps I can finally get some research of my own done.
I do not have any more chores for you. Check with the other mouths, and with my patron, Master Aryon.
The skins of many kinds of Daedra can be recovered from those who have recently been returned to Oblivion.
Did you deliver the cure blight potions?
Andil in Tel Vos is the apothecary you should speak with. Get three potions of cure blight and deliver them to Andil.
To get to Tel Fyr, you'll have to swim or fly southwest from Sadrith Mora. It's a long trip.
I am Galos Mathendis, mouth of Master Aryon.
I have *not* changed my mind. I do not intend for you to *ever* be the Telvanni Hortator. Fulfill the prophecies in your next incarnation, Nerevar.
I am Archmagister Gothren. And I do not suffer fools.
What brings you back to Caldera?
Hail, Nerevarine. You will always find a warm welcome here in Ebonheart for all you have done for my people.
House Hlaalu's business is in your hands now.
I have long believed it was a mistake to turn from the old gods. Perhaps Azura is with you after all. And perhaps not.
I believe we could work together. Yes, the more I consider the possibilities, the more I believe we would make excellent partners.

Hello, again. How are you doing? Bit of bad news, I'm afraid. The potion doesn't seem to work on others. Tried it on two hopeless cases. Killed them outright. Deader than a garlic snail. But anyway... is there anything I can help you with?
Yes, yes. You're completely cured. Did you forget something?
Well? Did you get my boots? No boots, no potion, I'm afraid....

Well! What a pleasure! A visitor! An entertaining diversion! Come to consult the great Divayth Fyr, have you? Do you have the divine disease? Want to plunder the dungeon? Or simply leer at my daughters?
No. You will never be the Archmaster of House Redoran. Meet me at the Arena in Vivec where I shall prove my right to rule in a duel to the death.
To be honest, I thought your story was crazy. All this talk about prophecies and reincarnated heroes and Daedra Lords appearing in caves... heh. I'm glad you've proven me wrong, Nerevarine.
Are you here to discuss the affairs of the council, Archmaster?
Are you here to discuss the affairs of the council?
Why are you here, Hortator? You should be taking the battle to our enemies, the Sixth House and the Empire!
What can I do for the friend that rescued my daughter?
You have rescued my daughter - I must apologize for the way I treated you. I will gladly offer my support to make you a Councilman.
So. You went all the way to Red Mountain, slew Dagoth Ur, and ended the Blight. I'm glad to see our trust in you was not misplaced.

What can I do for the Hortator of House Redoran?  A heavy title, laden with tradition and responsibility. I trust one as dedicated to the eradication of Dagoth Ur as you shall use the title in a responsible manner.
I have given you my vote as the new Redoran Hortator. Have the other councilors agreed?

You must explain why you have come here, and quickly. No speeches or excuses. Use your words with care, for I am a councilor of House Redoran and a very busy man with many duties and responsibilities.
I am a very busy man, outlander. I trust you will explain this reason for interrupting me yet again?
What do you want, outlander? I do not have the time or the patience to answer all your childish questions.
I asked you to collect the taxes from Gnisis. What news?
So you want my support on the Council. Very well, I shall grant support to an outlander, if they can prove themselves. First, I need someone to collect the taxes from Gnisis.
The devil-slayer returns. How can the Lord of West Gash help you, Nerevarine?
What do you need from the Lord of West Gash?
How may I serve you, Archmaster?
Congratulations on your promotion to the council. May you wield your influence justly.
Athyn Sarethi is a good man, and was a close friend of my father. You will find no better sponsor in all of House Redoran.
I don't have anymore duties for you. If you want to advance in House Redoran, you will need one of the councilors to sponsor you.
I heard there was an attack... is Athyn Sarethi safe?
I admire your sense of duty to the clan. But you would serve your house better by getting those wounds seen to.
Serjo Athyn Sarethi, a councilor of House Redoran, believes his life is in danger.
Our old friend Drulene Falen needs help again. Sounds like trouble with bandits.
Did you get the founders helm from Alvis Teri?
The godless Hlaalu have no honor.
Did you deliver the Cure Disease potion to Theldyn Virith?
I need someone to deliver a cure disease potion to Ald Velothi. It's a long hike, so make sure you're ready before setting out.
Have you taken care of those fearsome mudcrabs?
Drulene Falen has a mudcrab problem with her guar herds.
If you wish to join House Redoran, you have come to the right place.

Now that you are Guildmaster, rule the Guild wisely. Use your wisdom, experience, and judgement to the Guild's benefit. Remember those who helped you to attain your rank. If I was even a small part of your success, well, I feel honored.
Use your position as Guildmaster to try and protect the Fighters Guild, not by allying with such as the Camonna Tong, but with hard work and high standards.
Although Sjoring Hard-Heart is dead, we must not rest easily. I fear there are troubling times ahead, not just for the Fighters Guild, but for all of Tamriel.
In spite of his faults, Sjoring Hard-Heart is one of the best warriors in Vvardenfell. He'll be expecting you. Don't underestimate him.
We've spoken about the problems with Eydis Fire-Eye and Lorbumol already. So tell me what you have done.
I don't like spilling the blood of our brothers in arms. But it's the only way we can save the Guild.
Have you delivered that flin to the Elith-Pal Mine yet?
What's the status of those bandits in Suran? Have you had a chance to speak with Avon Oran yet?
Go to Suran and talk with Serjo Avon Oran. He can tell you more about these bandit attacks.
Nerer Beneran was once a member of House Redoran. Now he's just the leader of an outlaw band in Sargon, north of Maar Gan.
Do you have any new information on the situation in Vas?
Vas is far to the north, and the journey is a long one. Your best bet may be to take a ship to Dagon Fel from Tel Mora.
Are you here to discuss your orders? Or is there something else you want?
I don't have much work for anyone under the rank of Swordsman. These Redoran are honorable enough, and keep things pretty quiet.
I used to be the Master of the Fighters Guild - but now I'm retired here in Ald Ruhn. Do you want to join us? We're always looking for new recruits.
I'm glad the guild is being led by someone with your respect for scholarship, Arch-Mage.
Another interruption! Why I... ooh. Oh dear. Those wounds are serious, my friend.
Huleen's apprentice summoned a scamp? I can't believe I was distracted from my studies for something so trivial.
Currently the chair for Dwemer studies is empty - and the great houses can't agree on a replacement.
Officially, the Gnisis eggmine was closed because of blight... but I heard that miners broke into the lost Dwemer ruin of Bethamez!
The ruin is southwest of Dagon Fel. You'll need to swim or fly across parts of the Sea of Ghosts. Bring back any plans or blueprints you find!
Did you get the excavation report from Nchuleft?
Senilias Cadiusus is engaged in official Imperial research at the ruin. He was supposed to give me an excavation report every month... but it's late...
Have you found a Dwemer Tube? Many of my studies cannot continue until I have one.
Dwemer Tubes shouldn't be too hard to find. Go to Ald Velothi and travel along the coast to the west. You'll cross a bridge and you'll see Arkngthunch-Sturdumz ahead of you. You can't miss it!
I need you to return the book before Sirilonwe suspects anything - she's not one to be crossed lightly.
Since Huleen is a member of the Guild, we really ought to do something about the disturbance. I simply haven't had time to do it myself!
Most of the ancient tales are not truly Dwemer in origin - but this one may be an exception.
Did you get that detect creatures potion from Skink?
Trebonius is certainly a powerful battlemage, but... what has he accomplished?
What's so important that you would interrupt my studies?
I didn't realize how fast corprus kills. It sure wasn't pretty.
Caius Cosades sent you, didn't he? He says you're the one to handle this Sixth House base near Gnaar Mok.
The Temple was wrong. You are Lord Nerevar reborn - you've proven that. You've done what no one else can do, not even Lord Vivec. Of course we're grateful for what you've done.
Thank you for rescuing me. Now I'll stay here at Holamayan with Master Barelo and assist him with the monastery's library.
I'll meet you at Holamayan. When we get there, talk to Gilvas Barelo. He should be able to help you with the Lost Prophecies you seek.
Do you have the divine intervention scrolls? I have an escape plan.
As I said, get Caius a copy of 'Progress of Truth' and that should tell him what he needs to know.
Go ahead. I'm afraid I don't know anything about the Sixth House, but I can tell you about the Nerevarine Cult.
Yes, I'm Mehra Milo, a librarian for the Hall of Wisdom. Can I tell you about our collection?

Like Lord Nerevar, you have won the Battle of Red Mountain. And you bear Nerevar's great Ring, One-Clan-Under-Moon-and-Star. Will you make good Lord Nerevar's promises to the Ashlander tribes? We live in interesting times, my friend.
Hello again, my friend. I trust I find you well. Is there anything else you'd like to ask about? Or were you just looking for a good book?
I've told you what I know about the Nerevarine cult. I hope Caius finds it helpful.
We should be free from distraction here. Now, I said I'd tell you about the Nerevarine cult so you can report back to Caius.
We travel together to Jobasha's Rare Books. When we arrive at my friend's bookstore, I will answer your questions there.
I simply wish to go to my friend's bookstore, but these troublesome fools are trying to threaten me. They hate my race, and I think they are spoiling for a fight.
You're on your own now. Get Mehra Milo to help you find the lost prophecies. And... good luck.
You're looking much better my friend but... we need to talk.
Go to Tel Fyr and get that Corprus Disease cured. Then, hurry back - I think know how to get the lost prophecies Nibani Maesa asked for.
Good god my friend - your face! I think you may have contracted Corprus Disease.
Go talk to Raesa Pullia in Buckmoth Legion Fort. And beware Dagoth Gares - this mission won't be easy.
Did you speak with Hassour Zainsubani yet?
Find out what what Zainsubani likes, and get him a gift.
Did you speak with Mehra Milo yet? Make sure you've gotten everything she can tell me about the Sixth House and the Nerevarine cult. Then report back.
I've thought it over, and I want you to interview three informants in Vivec City concerning the Nerevarine and the Sixth House.

I'm not ready for you yet. And you're not at the level of performance I'm looking for yet. So, as I said, take some time to polish your skills and flesh out your cover story with a little freelance adventuring.
Did you get the information from Sharn Gra-Muzgob at the Mages Guild?
Go get the notes. Bring them to me - fly like the wind.
Do you have the notes from Hasphat Antabolis?
I'm just an old man with a skooma problem. What do you want?
I'm not working against the Thieves Guild anymore - you have my word.
Seems like just yesterday you were taking orders from me. But hey - the wheel turns, and fortune favours the bold.
You're no good to me dead. Get yourself bandaged up, and we'll talk about your orders later.
You made the Fighter's Guild look good in the eyes of the Duke. Friends in high places are always useful.
I'm sure the Sarano famly is grateful for your work. Lloros, the heir of the family, is a priest at the temple in Ald-Ruhn.
The Sarano Family Tomb is over the hills southeast of Fort Moonmonth, between the Ashlands and Lake Amaya.
Tell me what's happening with the Verethi Gang? I assume you've taken care of it?
Cut a path through his smuggler gang if you need to - but the contract is just for Dovres Verethi.
I sent you to investigate some orcs at the Duke's behest. What have you found out?
Alof's farm is north-east of Pelagiad and just north of the Arvel Plantation. This contract comes from the Duke himself - so don't screw this up.
Give me the status on Dura gra-Bol. Surely you haven't botched up this mission?
Orcs are tough fighters. Don't let her get the drop on ya.
Did you recover the debt money from Desele yet? Or were you just wasting time with her dancers?
You can take the siltstrider to Suran. The cornerclub shouldn't be hard to find - just don't get tempted by the girls or the skooma pipes. You've got a job to do.
You'll find Sottilde at the South Wall, across the river. It's a watering hole frequented by knaves and highwaymen, so watch your coinpurse.
What have you got on the Telvanni agents? The Caldera Mining Company expects results.
The quickest way to Caldera is to have the Mages Guild transport you. But hey - if you want to save septims or feel like the exercise, take the trail from the north gate instead.
What's the status on those egg poachers? Don't make me assign this to someone else.
Those kwama eggs are among the few things worth exporting from this nasty little province. Report back when the poachers are dead.
Have you taken care of that cave rat problem yet? Surely even you can handle that.
Go to Drarayne Thelas' house. It's here in Balmora, along the river on the east side.
Speak up, scuttle-butt! You wanna join the Fighters Guild? I'm the steward here in Balmora.
Those wounds are serious. Go see Ajira for a healing poultice, we can speak of your duties later.
Itermerel's notes were quite valuable to me. Thankyou, outlander.
There is one less necromancer here in Vvardenfell thanks to you.
How may I help you, Arch-Mage?
It's a shame that the guild is run by a scuttlehead with no sense or ambition like Trebonious.
I'm sure there's a spy. When you find them, do not take any action. Report back to me.
Go to Maar Gan. Find Tashpi Ashibael and kill her. The Mages Guild cannot tolerate necromancers.
I'm waiting for Itermerel's notes - do you have them yet?
Go find Itermerel and get his notes for me.
Well? Have you put a stop to that unsanctioned training?

This Argonian, whoever he is, does not have the sanction of the Mages Guild. The South Wall Cornerclub is the other side of the river Odai, in Labour Town. Lots of unsavoury types there - watch your back.
You've dealt with Manwe - but have you convinced Llarar Bereloth to join us?
You've dealt with Llarar Bereloth. Now what of Manwe's guild dues?
Have you convinced Llarar Bereloth to join us? And what of Manwe's guild dues?
If you can't convince Manwe, kill her. Don't come back here until you get some results.
Well do you want more duties or not?
I don't have any duties for someone of your rank. Why don't you speak with Ajira, downstairs? I believe she may have some small tasks for you.
Well outlander. I'm Ranis Athrys, head of the Mages Guild here in Balmora. Were you looking to join the Mages Guild?
Ajira knows that you are good friend of Ajira.
What can Ajira do for you?
Ajira must study these flowers and mushrooms.You know this. Why do you pester Ajira now?
You have flowers for Ajira?
You put the fake soul gem in Galbedir's desk?
You found the mushrooms Ajira needs?
The Devil is dead, and the blight is gone! You have conquered Red Mountain, destroyed Dagoth Ur and all his kin. We offer you our thanks in this happy hour.
What can I do for you, Master of the Guild?
Looks like your opponent almost got the upper hand. Get those wounds seen to, we can talk about your orders later.
I don't have any more work for you. Go talk to someone else about it. Maybe that old fool Mercius in Ald'ruhn.
No one knows exactly where the Pudai Egg Mine is. I believe it is somewhere on or near the island of Sheogorad north of here. It is said that there are seven eggs of gold there!
Try to avoid the other guards, and just kill Engaer. I need trouble with House Telvanni like I need a scrib in my sock.
You were sent to escort Sondaale of Shimmerene. Give me the status of your mission.
Get moving, already! I need you to escort Sondaale through Telasero.
Have you gotten that shipment to the Dunirai Caverns yet?
The Fighters Guild is responsible for supplying the Imperial mines in Vvardenfell. Yeah yeah, I know. It's not monster-slaying or outlaw hunting ...but it needs to be done.
Have you taken care of that Corprus Stalker in Berwen's shop yet? And what about that bounty I told you about? The one on Rels Tenim.
Rels Tenim is a murderer who escaped from justice. He was last seen near Vos.
Give me your report on the situation at Dissapla Mine.
Do whatever Novor says needs doing. He said something about... Nix Hounds getting loose... and attacking the miners.
Did you join Larienna Macrina in her expedition of those Dwemer ruins?
The Dwemer ruin is a fair trek south of Sadrith Mora. Help Larienna Macrina clear out the monsters there and report back to me.
The name's Hrundi, stranger. I'm the Fighters Guild steward of Wolverine Hall. And who might you be?
You're itching for action, I can tell. You here for more orders?
I gave you the contract on that Khajiit, Dro'Sakhar. Is he dead yet?

I don't have any orders for ya. Talk to Sjoring Hard-Heart the Guildmaster. If he doesn't have any orders for ya, check with Eydis Fire-Eye in Balmora or Hrundi in Sadrith Mora. I guess you could ask the old guildmaster in Ald'ruhn too.
I got orders for ya, so listen up.
I don't have orders for anyone under the rank of Protector. Earn your stripes, then we can talk.
You wanna join the Fighter's Guild? Maybe I got time for ya, and maybe I don't.
Uriel Septim was never a strong Emperor. And now he's finally dying of age and illness. A coward's death! At a time like this, only the Imperial Guilds with strong allies will survive.
You did quite a job on the local heads of the Thieves Guild. Now it's time to take care of the Master Thief.
Just kill the Thieves Guild bosses like I told ya. Then we can talk about the future of the Fighter's Guild.
You'll make a fine Guildmaster someday. But with all the unrest in Cyrodiil city, we need allies to make sure there's still a Fighter's Guild that survives.
Outander makes good, eh Nerevarine? First you're an outlaw, now you're a hero. You want my advice? Don't be shy, enjoy it while it lasts. You're only on top for so long.
Maybe I'll go back to Hammerfell, see the old family. Until I get back, I'm leaving the Guild in your capable hands.

We've tried bribes, blackmail, and even diplomacy, but Sjoring has some personal stake in this. It's time to end this war. You must go to the Fighters Guild here in Vivec... and kill Sjoring Hard-Heart!
Were you able to get rid of the brothers Ienith? I know they are powerful foes, but defeating them wounds our enemy greatly.
Navil and Ranes Ienith can be found on the Dren Plantation. The Thieves Guild won't be safe from the Camonna Tong until their best enforcers are dead.
What is the situation with Hrundi? Did you find his woman? Will he join our cause?
Hrundi has a Dunmer lover. If you can find out who she is, you can pressure Hrundi to join our cause.
The Bitter Cup was lost in the ruins of Ald Redaynia, which is on an island north of the Urshilaku Camp.
I sent you to speak to Percius Mercius and see if he was willing to help us fight. Tell me you have good news.

Percius Mercius is the Steward of the Guild of Fighters in Ald'ruhn. He used to be the Master of the Fighters Guild before the Camonna Tong got involved. I believe he will help us fight the Camonna Tong.
A fellow thief and a member of the Guild has gone missing. Would you track down Nads Tharen for me?
You're a fellow with a soft tread and a glint in his eye - I like that.
You're a girl with a soft tread and a glint in her eye. I like that.
Were you looking for a book back here? Or were you looking for trouble?
Welcome Grandmaster. How can I serve you today?
It's business as usual in Vivec. Speak with Crassius Curio at his manor here in the Hlaalu Compound or Nileno Dorvayn in Balmora.
Did you find the Prelude? If you did, do you have my wakizashi?
The ship was trying to land at a secret dock and is likely to be hard to find. I believe they crashed on an island east of Bal Fell.
Go! Speak with the Zainab camp and make sure they only sell ebony through us.
Go to Yngling Manor and kill the blighted rats, but spare his prized game rats... if you can.
Go to Odirniran. If there are any survivors, ask them what needs to be done. If there are no survivors, take revenge on the foul Telvanni there.
Meet Tarvyn Faren on the road to Pelagiad, near the Silt Strider just north of the bridge to the Foreign Quarter.
Murudius Flaeus owes a House Hlaalu noble over 800 drakes in gambling debts. Go to Hla Oad, and get the drakes from him.
Like I said. Deliver the sealed report to Baren Alen at the Hlaalu Treasury.
I don't believe we've met. My name is Edryno Arethi. I don't have any official title, but I handle House Hlaalu's business here in Vivec.
Yes, yes - you're the Hortator of House Hlaalu. Hope it wasn't too dear.
A pleasure doing business with you. And I'm a man of my word. You got my vote for the office of Hortator of House Hlaalu. Once you get everyone's vote, talk to Crassius Curio.
I'm Thaeril, publican of the Covenant. The beds and drinks are reasonably priced, and I swap the latest rumors for free. What'll it be?
I'm Sorosi Radobar, publican of the Flowers of Gold. Looking for beds? Hot food? Just say the word.

The hour draws long and the candles burns low - I'm Burcanius Varo, publican of the Varo tradehouse here in Vos. I expect you'll be wanting one of our beds? Or perhaps a glass of mulled Shein before you turn in?
