I'm Shenk, owner of the Shovel here in Caldera. At this hour, I'll fancy you'll be wanting one of our beds. I can have food sent up if you like, or perhaps some local Mazte, and your fill of the latest rumors?
I'm Manara Othan, publican of the Lizard's Head. If you're looking for beds, just say so. Or perhaps something to drink, and we can swap the latest rumours?
I'm Llorayna Sethan, publican of the tradehouse here in Tel Branora. Are you ready for one of our beds? I can have a servant prepare sheets and supper, if you say the word.
I'm Fara, and this is my little hole in the wall. I expect you'll be wanting one of our beds? Or perhaps a glass of mulled Shien before you turn in?
I'm Ery, publican of the Gateway Inn here in Sadrith Mora. I expect you'll be wanting one of our beds for the night? If you can't sleep, I'm always here to trade the latest rumors and tattle-tale.
I'm Dulnea Ralaal, publican of the Eight Plates here in Balmora. You looking for one of our beds for the night? The sheets are fresh, and the rooms are clean.
I'm Drelasa Ramothran, publican of the Halfway Tavern here in Pelagiad. I expect you'll be wanting one of our beds - or perhaps a glass of mulled Shien before you turn in?

It's late, friend. Dark hours for dark business, as they say. Go warm yourself by the fire downstairs and have a jug of Mazte or two. Or perhaps you'll want one of our beds for the night? I imagine you'll want to sleep in tomorrow, given the hour.

A fine evening to you friend. Warm yourself by the fire downstairs and have a jug of Mazte or two. Plenty of colourful characters who will talk your ear off if you're not carefull. Or perhaps you'd like one of our beds for the night?
Good Day. I'm Bacola Closcius, publican of the South Wall here in Balmora. We rent beds, and I have local drinks in the cellar if you have the thirst.
It's late my friend - why not turn in for the night in one of our beds? Perhaps a mulled glass of Shien to keep out the chill.

Come on in, traveller. You don't want to be wandering Ebonheart on a cold night like this. Warm yourself by the fire, and when you're ready, let's see about fixing you one of our soft beds or some hot food.
Good day. I'm Agning, publican of the Six Fishes here in Ebonheart. We rent beds, and I've got hot food, locally sourced and priced to move.
A fair morn to you, my friend. We're still serving breakfast if you wanted to some cold scraps and watered Mazte. Or perhaps a warm pot of bittergreen tea, to get the blood flowing?
What can I get you, my friend? A little early for a mug of Grief, perhaps - but then again, it's how the sea reavers start the day, eh?
Yes, my friend. I promise you my aid and counsel.
So. My champion Zabamund has sent you to talk with me about the Nerevarine prophecies. Then go ahead, outlander. Talk. I am very curious.
Yes, outlander. You wish to talk with me about the Nerevarine prophecies. Go ahead. I am very curious.
Welcome, friend. They say your words and deeds have pleased our chief and wise woman.
Welcome, friend. Hearth and hand are yours.
So. You are the outlander who claims to fulfill the Nerevarine prophecies. You are welcome to our hospitality. But you must tell us... how can an outlander be the Nerevarine?
You have lost, outlander. So where is my exquisite shirt?
Well, outlander? Are you ready to begin our ritual challenge?
Welcome, outlander. Ashkhan Kaushad is always ready to listen.
I thank you for your lessons, outlander. I shall become ashkhan of the Erabenimsun. And I will name you Nerevarine.
Welcome, my friend. Did you wish to ask about the Ashlanders and the Nerevarine cult? Or was there some other business you have with me?
I am Hassour Zainsubani. May you bless and be blessed. I do not wish to be rude, but if you have business, speak it, for I am at leisure, and would prefer to be alone with my thoughts.
I am Hassour Zainsubani. I do not wish to be rude, but I am at leisure, and would prefer to be alone with my thoughts.
They say someone hit the Camonna Tong at the Council Club. And I mean *hard*. And the guards SAY they're very concerned, and they're following all leads... but somehow they don't seem very sincere.
Welcome to Balmora. We're a House Hlaalu town, and loyal citizens of the Empire. What can I do for you?
This town is Balmora, council seat of House Hlaalu. We're loyal citizens of the Empire, and proud of it. Well... most of us, anyway.
Listen, pilgrim. Even natives get confused in Vivec. What are you looking for?
This is the sacred city of Vivec. Count your blessings.
Listen, outlander. Even natives get confused in the cantons - what are you looking for?
Meet me in the arena! Let us make it shake with our mighty magic!
Greetings. I am Arch-Mage Trebonius, Guildmaster of Vivec.
Yes, I've given you my vote as Hortator. I just wish I could see Berel Sala's face right now.
Weren't you the one who was going to deliver my ash yams? What took you so long? I've got all these kwama eggs.. and no ash yams... because I hate ash yams.
Are you here to feed the spiders?
I see that you were taken in by that bounty hunter. Fear not. It is not uncommon for them to come looking here. I thank you for your help, and for your intentions.
It's good to be out of the hands of the those cultists.
Please, can you help me! My wife has been taken by cultists!
Thank the gods you found her. I can only imagine what those bastards had planned for my Malexa.
So. You're the Nerevarine, eh? Whoop-tee-doo. Don't have much call for Nerevarines down this way. Good day!
You're not from round 'ere, are ya? Then it's just as well ya keep moving. We don't much like strangers round here. Good day.
You have ambition, outlander. And I like that.
How does the day find you? The beaten path holds no surprises, as we Telvanni say.
Don't be shy outlander, we don't bite. Or rather in Telvanni territory, we only bite fools.
Curiosity killed the Khajiit, outlander. Weigh your words carefully.
Forbidden fruits taste the sweetest, my friend.
Conscience makes cowards of us all, outlander.
Old ways are the best ways. Too many travellers forget their manners.
I'm happy to talk with a keen mind, such as yours.
Hail, friend. May you live for a century, and learn for a century.
No, go ahead. You're not like the rest of those fools.
Let no new thing arise, outlander. You're in Telvanni territory, so watch your manners.
Conscience makes cowards of us all, outlander. So spit it out.

The Mages Guild is a halfway house for those with the mystical apptitude to slowly float a quill over a parchment, or light lanterns with incantations a Dark Elf child masters before their fifth year. In short, we see you as a bunch of halfwits. Good day!
Welcome Archmagister. How can I serve you?
You're challenging Gothren, right? I don't know if you're brave or stupid.
What brings the new Master of Tel Ulvirith here?
Welcome, Wizard. Your ambition is an inspiration to us all.
Welcome, Spellwright. Your ambition is an inspiration to us all.
Ah, the new mouth of Master Aryon. What can I do for you?
I watch your ascent through House Telvanni with great interest, outlander.
Huh. Looks like they'll let anyone into House Telvanni these days.
You Hlaalu think you're pretty slick, eh? But I see right through you.
You here to talk me to death about duty and honor, Redoran?
Only wine and demons speak the truth, Redoran.
Better a drop of knowledge than a river of gold, Hlaalu.
Temple business, is it? Well, you tend your marshmerrow, and we'll tend ours.

I said I would accompany you, to see if you had made Ald Daedroth safe for the Ahemmusa. You have fulfilled my conditions. Thank you. The Ahemmusa shall be saved. And if you wish, now I shall name you Nerevarine of the Ahemmusa.
I am Sonummu, wise woman of the Zainab. Do you come for my services, or my counsel?
Don't be shy outlander. We don't bite. Or rather, in Telvanni territory, we only bite fools.
I am Manirai, wise woman of the Erabenimsun. Do you need my services? Or do you seek my counsel?
What. Yakum. Me? Speak Ashland. Not speak so good Old Elf. Sorry.

So. They've told me of you, outlander. Or, shall I say, Clanfriend. You are hard-headed. And ignorant. But perhaps it is not your fault. My lord ashkhan says you will ask me about the Nerevarine prophecies. He also says I will test you against them. I must do as my lord ashkhan says. So ask your question, and I will test you.
The Nerevarine? It's a surprise to see you here.
Nerevarine - it's a surprise to see you here.
